csrfToken.description: With the session cookie, every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE also sends the `nature_csrf` cookie's value in this header (403 otherwise).
csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token

portalSession.description: Browser session from native or enterprise (OIDC) sign-in. Every mutation also requires the X-CSRF-Token header.

userApiCredential.description: A NATURE-issued opaque bearer credential for one ordinary User, sent as `Authorization: Bearer nuc_...` over HTTPS only. Not an OAuth access token; never accepted in a query parameter, body or cookie. Grants identity only - authority is the User's own.
